notes: [2026-10-14, rubrik transcript] IOSP-1011 (Pure-based backup) and IOSP-1014 (confirm Pure backup works) treated as complete: Earle Long and Calvin Cochran said it has run several days without issues.

Shipment (IOSP-1010) held up by procurement contracts; Calvin will not move the date up until procurement signs. Physical work is by Tech X resold via MicroAge; two Sectigo people must be present in the cage (Olu plus a second person via Jamie).

Calvin: Rubrik should only be on backup VLANs. Rubrik is configured for VLAN 130 and 2988 only. Maintenance starts 7 PM Eastern; Rubrik initial 16-hour run therefore cannot start Saturday night. Earle suggested starting the Rubrik initial backup 1 PM UTC Sunday 10/18; Prajeet accepted running Rubrik and the existing RMAN backups concurrently (weekend).
[2026-10-14, rubrik transcript] Single Oracle database on shared disk with two instances (RAC1/RAC2). Prajeet: ideally point Rubrik at the SCAN host name, not IPs.

[2026-10-14, rubrik chat] Igor Kulyk reviewed Confluence objectives with Aylin and proposed removing 'Onboard Postgres backups to Rubrik' from the 2026 objectives (asked Calvin and SriChand to confirm); objectives added to IOSP-471.
[2026-10-14, rubrik chat] Calvin Cochran: 'Option 2' (backup-VLAN approach) is supported by Rubrik (slightly different from first stated, functionally equivalent).

[2026-10-14, rubrik chat] Earle Long asked when the SASP backup recovery is to be done (recover a Rubrik SASP backup onto bdddcanlora3/5); Igor noted it had not been discussed in weekly calls; Earle clarified he meant 'Recover', Igor accepted it as the SASP recover step.

[2026-10-14, status email] Overall status ON-TRACK. Shipment pending updates from Karl and procurement. Waiting for Oracle response (Prajeet), then Calvin creates the RM ticket for the maintenance window. Meeting with Network team next week so everything is ready for Rubrik in Manchester. Timeline in email: IOSP-1012 10/16 6PM UTC (Sri); IOSP-880 10/17-10/20; IOSP-1013 10/21 (Sri, Calvin); IOSP-1010 10/21-TBD (Karl/Calvin, procurement); IOSP-1015 international shipment Oct 27-Nov 9; IOSP-1009 Oct 23-Nov 23 (Earle); IOSP-1004/1005 Nov 9-16 (Manchester infra, Priya/Mena); IOSP-1006 Nov 16-Dec 6 (Calvin, Sri); IOSP-1007 Nov 30-Dec 6; IOSP-1008 fully production in Europe Dec 7.

Earle Long and Calvin Cochran (10/15): standalone Oracle in Secaucus only supports the Rubrik POC; Calvin proposed decommissioning by first week of November (maybe last week of October). Earle: Prajeet agreed to do the work in a SASP maintenance window; proposed pencilling it into the next maintenance on 2026-11-14 because of a heavy weekend.

risks: Shipment (IOSP-1010/1015) depends on procurement signing contracts; Calvin will not move dates earlier without it.
RAC nodes lacked a CA Backup VLAN interface; any change on production SCDPCA RAC1 requires an RM ticket and a maintenance window, and it crosses the boundary between Rubrik and the CA environment.
Rubrik is configured only for VLAN 130 and 2988; SCAN/VIP-based connection may impact production client traffic (shared VIPs) - unresolved pending Oracle and Rubrik support answers.
Rubrik initial 16-hour run overlapping existing RMAN primary backups (backup window increased from 4h to 6h); could overlap into Monday morning.
If RAC node 1 is down, Rubrik backups from node 1 stop until reconfigured (Prajeet/Earle discussion).
Schedule slip: IOSP-1012 was planned 10/16 6PM UTC and ran 10/18; Calvin noted 'we are already behind'.
Possible conflict on standalone Oracle decommission timing: Calvin proposes late Oct/first week Nov; Earle proposes 14-Nov-2026 maintenance.
